name: @saccolabs/questrade-mcp

tools.name: qt_get_context
tools.description: Start here. Returns how credentials are configured (and the exact sign-in command when they are missing), the accounts this login reaches, which one is the default, Questrade's server time and what the API cannot do. Works without credentials and then explains how to sign in.

tools.name: qt_list_accounts
tools.description: List the Questrade accounts this login reaches: number (the accountId other tools take), type (TFSA, RRSP, FHSA, Margin, Cash…), client type and status.

tools.name: qt_get_balances
tools.description: Cash, market value, total equity, buying power and maintenance excess for one account. perCurrency shows the CAD and USD sides separately; combined expresses the whole account in each currency. startOfDay adds the same figures as of the market open.

accountId.description: Account number from qt_get_context or qt_list_accounts; defaults to QUESTRADE_ACCOUNT_ID or the only account

tools.name: qt_list_positions
tools.description: Holdings in one account: quantity, average cost, price, market value, open and day P&L, and each position's weight within its currency. totals (per currency) always cover every position, not just this page. For all accounts at once use qt_run_report allocation.

accountId.description: Account number from qt_get_context or qt_list_accounts; defaults to QUESTRADE_ACCOUNT_ID or the only account

search.description: Filter by symbol or description (contains, case-insensitive)

tools.name: qt_list_activities
tools.description: Account activity: trades, dividends, deposits, withdrawals, interest, fees, transfers and FX conversions, newest first. Filter by type, action, symbol or text. totals (count and net amount by type and currency) cover every matching activity, not just this page. Default range: the last 30 days. Any range works (split into 30-day requests and cached briefly).

accountId.description: Account number from qt_get_context or qt_list_accounts; defaults to QUESTRADE_ACCOUNT_ID or the only account

startDate.description: Start: YYYY-MM-DD (a Toronto day) or an ISO date-time with an offset, e.g. 2026-01-02T09:30:00-05:00

endDate.description: End (inclusive): YYYY-MM-DD (a Toronto day) or an ISO date-time with an offset, e.g. 2026-01-02T09:30:00-05:00

type.description: Activity type contains, e.g. Trades, Dividends, Deposits, Withdrawals, Interest, Fees

action.description: Exact action, e.g. Buy, Sell, DIV, CON (contribution)

detail.description: summary: key fields, long text clipped. full: every field Questrade returns

tools.name: qt_list_executions
tools.description: Trade executions (fills) with price, quantity, commission and fees, newest first. Filter by symbol, side or orderId. Default range: the last 30 days. Any range works (split into 30-day requests and cached briefly).

accountId.description: Account number from qt_get_context or qt_list_accounts; defaults to QUESTRADE_ACCOUNT_ID or the only account

startDate.description: Start: YYYY-MM-DD (a Toronto day) or an ISO date-time with an offset, e.g. 2026-01-02T09:30:00-05:00

endDate.description: End (inclusive): YYYY-MM-DD (a Toronto day) or an ISO date-time with an offset, e.g. 2026-01-02T09:30:00-05:00

tools.name: qt_list_orders
tools.description: Orders (read-only history): open, filled, cancelled, rejected. Filter by state or symbol; newest first. Default range: the last 30 days. Any range works (split into 30-day requests and cached briefly).

accountId.description: Account number from qt_get_context or qt_list_accounts; defaults to QUESTRADE_ACCOUNT_ID or the only account

startDate.description: Start: YYYY-MM-DD (a Toronto day) or an ISO date-time with an offset, e.g. 2026-01-02T09:30:00-05:00

endDate.description: End (inclusive): YYYY-MM-DD (a Toronto day) or an ISO date-time with an offset, e.g. 2026-01-02T09:30:00-05:00

detail.description: summary: key fields, long text clipped. full: every field Questrade returns

tools.name: qt_get_order
tools.description: Every field of one order (legs, routes, commissions, timestamps). Its fills: qt_list_executions with orderId.

accountId.description: Account number from qt_get_context or qt_list_accounts; defaults to QUESTRADE_ACCOUNT_ID or the only account

tools.name: qt_search_symbols
tools.description: Find symbols by ticker prefix or a word in the company/fund name, e.g. "XEQT" or "shopify". Returns symbolId (what quotes, candles and analysis take), exchange and currency. TSX listings end in .TO; filter by exchange or currency to pick the right listing.

query.description: Ticker prefix or a word in the description

exchange.description: Only this listing exchange, e.g. TSX, NASDAQ, NYSE, TSXV, NEO

securityType.description: e.g. Stock, Option, Bond, MutualFund, Index

offset.description: Skip this many of Questrade's results; use nextOffset

tools.name: qt_get_symbols
tools.description: Details for up to 50 symbols: description, exchange, currency, previous close, 52-week range, average volume, EPS, P/E, dividend, yield, ex-date, market cap, sector and whether it has options.

items.description: symbolId (number) or exact ticker, e.g. "XEQT.TO" (TSX) or "AAPL" (US)

detail.description: summary: key fields, long text clipped. full: every field Questrade returns

tools.name: qt_get_quotes
tools.description: Level 1 quotes for up to 100 symbols: last, bid/ask, size, day range, volume and change from the previous close. delay > 0 means the account's data subscription delays this market.

items.description: symbolId (number) or exact ticker, e.g. "XEQT.TO" (TSX) or "AAPL" (US)

detail.description: summary: key fields, long text clipped. full: every field Questrade returns

tools.name: qt_list_markets
tools.description: Markets Questrade supports (TSX, TSXV, NYSE, NASDAQ, …) with today's regular and extended hours and currency.

detail.description: summary: key fields, long text clipped. full: every field Questrade returns

tools.name: qt_get_option_chain
tools.description: Option chain for an underlying. Without expiryDate: the expiry dates (with strike counts). With expiryDate: strikes with call and put symbolIds, by default the ones nearest the last price; pass minStrike/maxStrike for others. Quotes and Greeks: qt_get_option_quotes with those IDs.

symbol.description: symbolId (number) or exact ticker, e.g. "XEQT.TO" (TSX) or "AAPL" (US)

expiryDate.description: Expiry date, YYYY-MM-DD (from the list this tool returns without it)

tools.name: qt_get_option_quotes
tools.description: Quotes for up to 100 option symbolIds (from qt_get_option_chain): bid/ask, last, volume, open interest, implied volatility and the Greeks (delta, gamma, theta, vega, rho).

detail.description: summary: key fields, long text clipped. full: every field Questrade returns

tools.name: qt_get_candles
tools.description: Price history for one symbol: summary stats (change, high, low, average volume), an ASCII chart of closes and OHLCV rows newest first (limit/offset). Questrade returns at most 2000 candles per request, so match interval to the range. Default range by interval: 1 year of daily, 5 years of weekly, 5 days of intraday.

symbol.description: symbolId (number) or exact ticker, e.g. "XEQT.TO" (TSX) or "AAPL" (US)

startDate.description: Start: YYYY-MM-DD (a Toronto day) or an ISO date-time with an offset, e.g. 2026-01-02T09:30:00-05:00

endDate.description: End (inclusive): YYYY-MM-DD (a Toronto day) or an ISO date-time with an offset, e.g. 2026-01-02T09:30:00-05:00

interval.description: Candle size; Questrade returns at most 2000 candles per request

chart.description: Include an ASCII chart of closes

limit.description: OHLCV rows to return, newest first (0 = stats and chart only)

tools.name: qt_compare_symbols
tools.description: Compare up to 10 symbols over the same range: % change, high, low, maximum drawdown and a normalized % change chart. Default range: 1 year of daily candles.

items.description: symbolId (number) or exact ticker, e.g. "XEQT.TO" (TSX) or "AAPL" (US)

startDate.description: Start: YYYY-MM-DD (a Toronto day) or an ISO date-time with an offset, e.g. 2026-01-02T09:30:00-05:00

endDate.description: End (inclusive): YYYY-MM-DD (a Toronto day) or an ISO date-time with an offset, e.g. 2026-01-02T09:30:00-05:00

tools.name: qt_analyze_technicals
tools.description: Technical indicators for one symbol: RSI 14, SMA 50 and 200, VWAP, Bollinger Bands (20, 2) and signals (oversold, above SMA 200, …). Default range: 1 year of daily candles (about 250, enough for SMA 200).

symbol.description: symbolId (number) or exact ticker, e.g. "XEQT.TO" (TSX) or "AAPL" (US)

startDate.description: Start: YYYY-MM-DD (a Toronto day) or an ISO date-time with an offset, e.g. 2026-01-02T09:30:00-05:00

endDate.description: End (inclusive): YYYY-MM-DD (a Toronto day) or an ISO date-time with an offset, e.g. 2026-01-02T09:30:00-05:00

interval.description: Candle size; Questrade returns at most 2000 candles per request

tools.name: qt_screen_watchlist
tools.description: Screen up to 50 symbols against technical criteria (RSI bounds, above SMA 50/200, piercing the lower Bollinger Band, below VWAP). Returns the matches with their indicators, and why the others failed.

items.description: symbolId (number) or exact ticker, e.g. "XEQT.TO" (TSX) or "AAPL" (US)

startDate.description: Start: YYYY-MM-DD (a Toronto day) or an ISO date-time with an offset, e.g. 2026-01-02T09:30:00-05:00

endDate.description: End (inclusive): YYYY-MM-DD (a Toronto day) or an ISO date-time with an offset, e.g. 2026-01-02T09:30:00-05:00

interval.description: Candle size; Questrade returns at most 2000 candles per request

tools.name: qt_run_report
tools.description: Portfolio reports computed from live Questrade data, across all active accounts unless accountId is given. portfolio_summary: equity, cash and market value per account and in total. allocation: positions combined across accounts by symbol, with weights and a breakdown by security type. dividend_income: dividends by symbol and by month (startDate/endDate; default year to date). activity_summary: activity by type and currency, net deposits per account and commissions (default year to date). Rows are paginated with limit/offset; totals always cover every row; each report states its basis.

accountId.description: Account number from qt_get_context or qt_list_accounts; defaults to QUESTRADE_ACCOUNT_ID or the only account

startDate.description: Start: YYYY-MM-DD (a Toronto day) or an ISO date-time with an offset, e.g. 2026-01-02T09:30:00-05:00

endDate.description: End (inclusive): YYYY-MM-DD (a Toronto day) or an ISO date-time with an offset, e.g. 2026-01-02T09:30:00-05:00

instructions:
Questrade brokerage, read-only. Call qt_get_context first; if credentials are missing or rejected the user signs in with node /pkg/node_modules/@saccolabs/questrade-mcp/bin/questrade-mcp.js login in a terminal on 7563384ebfd2. Full guide: the questrade://guide resource.
- Read-only: no tool places, changes or cancels orders.
- Call qt_get_context first: it shows the accounts and the default one. Account tools take an optional accountId; with several accounts and no default they ask for one.
- Lists are paginated (page/pageSize, or offset/limit for reports and candles). Ask for small pages, follow nextPage/nextOffset only when needed, and prefer detail="summary".
- Symbols: pass a symbolId or the exact ticker ("XEQT.TO" for the TSX, "AAPL" for the US). qt_search_symbols finds them.
- Dates: YYYY-MM-DD (Toronto days) or ISO date-times with an offset. Activity, execution and order lists default to the last 30 days and accept any range.
- qt_run_report computes portfolio_summary, allocation, dividend_income and activity_summary across accounts; every report states its basis.
- Never ask the user to paste a token into the chat. The user signs in in a terminal on 7563384ebfd2: node /pkg/node_modules/@saccolabs/questrade-mcp/bin/questrade-mcp.js login. You may run node /pkg/node_modules/@saccolabs/questrade-mcp/bin/questrade-mcp.js check yourself to verify; it prints no secrets.
